questions.stem: This is the first present ____ I got from my parents.

options.distractor: 序数词修饰时只用 that

questions.explanation: 序数词 first 修饰 → 只用 that。

questions.stem: Is there anything ____ I can do for you?
questions.explanation: 先行词是不定代词 anything → 只用 that。

questions.stem: She is the only student ____ can answer this question.

options.distractor: 先行词是人，且 the only 后只用 that

questions.explanation: 被 the only 修饰 → 只用 that。

questions.stem: He told me all ____ he knew about the accident.

options.distractor: 先行词是不定代词 all，只用 that

questions.explanation: 先行词是 all → 只用 that。

options.text: This is the best novel that I have read.
Nothing that he said was true.
The driver and his car which fell into the river were saved.
It is the very book that I want.

questions.explanation: 人和物同时作先行词 → 只用 that。

questions.stem: — Who is the boy ____ is standing at the gate? — He is my brother.

options.distractor: 主句以 who 开头时避免用 who，也不用 which

questions.explanation: 主句以 who 开头的疑问句，从句关系词用 that。
